result.instructions: Tools for CareLineLive, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which carers are on leave next week?"; "Show me the carers whose payroll number starts with 1042, and their teams."; "List the clients in our East team, page by page.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes CareLineLive data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run carelinelive_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run carelinelive_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run carelinelive_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. carelinelive_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: carelinelive_list_carers
tools.title: List carers
tools.description: List carers (care workers) in the CareLineLive environment, with their contract, team and employment fields. Filters are partial matches; not_on_leave excludes carers on leave in a period. CareLineLive API: GET /api/v2/carers.

not_on_leave.description: Exclude carers with leave overlapping this period: 'from,to' as YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD (to must be after from).

include.description: Comma-separated related resources to include in the reply, for example 'teams'.

page.description: Page number (default 1). The reply's links.next and meta.pagination show whether more pages exist.

tools.name: carelinelive_update_carer
tools.title: Update carer payroll details
tools.description: Change a carer's payroll number, payroll department code or cost centre code. Only the fields you send change; sending the same values again has no further effect. Other carer fields are not changed by this tool. CareLineLive API: PATCH /api/v2/carers/{carer}.

payroll_number.description: New payroll number, or null to clear it.

payroll_department_code.description: New payroll department code, or null to clear it.

cost_centre_code.description: New cost centre code, or null to clear it.
